description: Android AAR for the bitHuman essence-2 avatar engine: drives an avatar bundle and composes teeth BORROWED from the donor bank rather than synthesizing them. A self-hosted session is metered at the published self-hosted rate (https://docs.bithuman.ai/guides/pricing). Bundles the engine's native library plus libonnxruntime.so and libc++_shared.so for arm64-v8a.
